stud_schedule_notes: 1. STUD SECTIONS AND HEIGHT LIMITS ARE BASED ON US GYPSUM DATA.
2. HEIGHT LIMIT IS FOR A TYPICAL CASE WITH STUDS 16" ON CENTER, 1 LAYER OF GYPSUM BOARD EACH SIDE.
3. A 5PSF LIVE LOAD ACTING NORMAL TO THE FACE OF THE PARTITION.
4. MAXIMUM ALLOWABLE DEFLECTION SHALL BE L/240 OF THE UNBRACED HEIGHT.
5. INCREASED STUD GAGE OR SPACING MAY BE REQUIRED DUE TO HEIGHT OR PARTITION. REFER TO US GYPSUM PRODUCT DATA FOR OTHER CONDITIONS.
general_notes: 1. REFER TO TITLE SHEET(S) AND PROJECT MANUAL FOR GENERAL PROJECT NOTES, SYMBOLS, AND ABBREVIATIONS.
2. NOT ALL PARTITION TYPES DELINEATED MAY BE USED.
3. REFER TO PLANS FOR DESIGNATION OF PARTITION TYPES AND RATINGS.
4. ALL METAL STUD AND C.M.U. PARTITIONS ARE TO EXTEND TO UNDERSIDE OF STRUCTURE UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
5. WHERE TWO DIFFERING PARTITION TYPES ABUT IN A LINE AND ALONG A CONTINUOUS LENGTH OF PARTITIONS, THE CONTINUOUS FINISHED SURFACES OF THESE PARTITIONS SHALL ALIGN UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
6. ALL METAL STUDS TO BE SPACED @ 16" O.C. UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE. REFER TO STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS.
7. PROVIDE FOR 1" DEFLECTION AT ALL PARTITION HEADS UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE. PROVIDE MINIMUM 3" DEEP-LEG TRACKS.
8. PROVIDE MINIMUM DOUBLE STUD AT EACH DOOR JAMB.
9. DO NOT PLACE GYPSUM BOARD JOINT AT CORNER OF DOOR FRAME.
10. USE 5/8" TYPE "X" GYPSUM BOARD AT RATED PARTITIONS. USE 5/8" GYPSUM BOARD AT ALL OTHER LOCATIONS UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
11. USE WATER-RESISTANT GYPSUM BOARD FOR WALLS IN ALL TOILET ROOMS, JANITOR'S CLOSETS, SHOWER ROOMS, EXTERIOR LOCATIONS, PARKING GARAGE AREAS, AND AS NOTED OTHERWISE.
12. USE WATER-RESISTANT GYPSUM BOARD FOR CEILINGS IN SHOWER ROOMS. MINIMUM FRAMING TO BE IN ACCORDANCE WITH IBC 2509.3.
13. USE CEMENTITIOUS BACKER UNITS AND SPACE STUDS AT 16" O.C. AT PARTITIONS TO RECEIVE CERAMIC TILE OR STONE.
14. PARTITIONS WHICH DO NOT GO TO STRUCTURE ABOVE SHALL HAVE INTERSECTING PARTITION OR BE BRACED TO STRUCTURE @ 12' O.C.
15. PROVIDE CONTROL JOINTS IN CEILINGS EXCEEDING 2500 S.F. AND IN PARTITIONS, WALLS, AND FURRING RUNS EXCEEDING 30 FT. VERIFY EXACT LOCATIONS WITH ARCHITECT. SEE DETAILS.
16. THROUGH-PENETRATIONS IN RATED PARTITIONS SHALL BE FIRESTOPPED IN ACCORDANCE WITH 2018 IBC, SECTION 714.4.1.
17. MEMBRANE-PENETRATIONS IN RATED PARTITIONS SHALL BE IN ACCORDANCE WITH 2018 IBC, SECTION 714.4.2
18. PROVIDE ACOUSTICAL SEALANT AT ALL PENETRATIONS IN ACOUSTICAL PARTITIONS.
19. ACOUSTICAL BATT INSULATION TO TERMINATE AT THE STRUCTURE UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
20. WHERE WALLS OR PARTITIONS ARE REQUIRED TO HAVE A FIRE-RESISTANCE RATING, RECESSED FIXTURES SHALL BE INSTALLED SUCH THAT THE REQUIRED WILL NOT BE REDUCED.

21. 2018 IBC, SECTION 708.4 CONTINUITY. FIRE PARTITIONS SHALL EXTEND FROM THE TOP OF THE FOUNDATION OR FLOOR/ CEILING ASSEMBLY BELOW TO THE UNDERSIDE OF THE FLOOR OR ROOF SHEATHING, SLAB OR DECK ABOVE OR TO THE FIRE-RESISTANCE RATED FLOOR/ CEILING OR ROOF CEILING ASSEMBLY. WHERE PARTITIONS ARE NOT CONTINUOUS THEY SHALL BE FIREBLOCKED OR DRAFTSTOPPED PER IBC 718.2 AND 718.3 AT THE PARTITION LINE.

22. IN INTERIOR WALLS WHERE ACOUSTIC INSULATION IS REQUIRED, R-13 FIBERGLASS BATT IS TO BE USED W/ 2 1/2" MTL STUDS, R-15 FIBERGLASS BATT IS TO BE USED W/ 3 5/8" MTL STUDS, AND R-19 FIBERGLASS BATT INSULATION IS TO BE USED W/ 6" MTL STUDS UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED.
23. SHAFT WALLS (heading only - no text printed)
24. HORIZONTAL ASSEMBLIES (heading only - no text printed)

25. ALL FIRE-RESISTIVE PARTITIONS SHALL BE CONSTRUCTED IN FULL COMPLIANCE WITH TESTING REQUIREMENTS AND MANUFACTURER'S RECOMMENDATIONS FOR CONDITIONS AS REQUIRED. CONSTRUCTION OF ALL SYSTEMS SHALL EQUAL THAT OF THE TESTED ASSEMBLY. CONTRACTOR MAY SUBSTITUTE ANOTHER LISTED ASSEMBLY FOR THAT INDICATED WITH PRIOR APPROVAL OF THE ARCHITECT AND THE BUILDING DEPARTMENT. TESTING FACILITIES ARE ABBREVIATED AS FOLLOWS: UL - UNDERWRITERS LABORATORIES INC.; GA - GYPSUM ASSOCIATION; NER - NATIONAL EVALUATION REPORT; WHI - WARNOCK HERSEY INTERNATIONAL
